name: Regime-armed momentum with non-crowded funding guard (gate is macro, not the funding filter)
rationale: THESIS: A risk-on macro_regime tells you the tape rewards risk; funding_rate (BOUNDED, ~+/-0.01) tells you whether the perp crowd is already maximally long. The worst trend entry is into a euphoric macro window where funding is ALSO blown out — that is a crowded long primed for a long-squeeze. So I arm spot momentum only when macro_regime>floor AND ret_Nd>mom_floor AND funding_rate<crowd_ceiling (positioning not yet crowded). The macro gate is the orthogonal regime piece; the funding ceiling is squeeze-avoidance. funding_rate is a populated BOUNDED feature so the lt level threshold is honest. DISCONFIRMER: run the SAME entry with macro_regime DROPPED but the funding_rate<crowd_ceiling guard kept (funding-gated momentum). If the funding-only version reproduces the macro+funding net-of-fee Sharpe, the macro gate is redundant to a positioning filter and adds no orthogonal macro info — falsified. The macro gate must add net edge over the funding-only version.
catalyst: Risk-on macro regime with positive trend but perp funding not yet crowded-long — the window arms momentum before the crowd piles in.
